metric_definitions.return: Realized closing cash-plus-marked-shares divided by initial wealth, minus one; includes archived fees.
metric_definitions.volatility: Sample standard deviation of closing wealth or equal-weight asset simple returns per model decision step, ddof=1; not annualized.
metric_definitions.drawdown: Maximum closing-value fall from the running peak including initial wealth; no intraday drawdown inferred.
metric_definitions.concentration: Largest closing single-asset market value divided by that account's NAV; and explicit concentration-breach account-steps.
metric_definitions.risk: Closing position covariance risk and stock-weight constraints using the recorded pre-decision covariance; not real-market VaR.
metric_definitions.execution: Keep requested, accepted, filled, fee and cash-clipped quantities separate; ratios with zero denominator remain null.
metric_definitions.ranges: All five seed minima, medians and maxima, not statistical confidence intervals or independent market observations.

historical_nonexecuted_document_resoluti.reason: Nonexecuted planning document changed with verified progress; exact frozen bytes remain in the preserved snapshot. Model, source data, roles and all other bindings are unchanged.
